notes.title: V1.01 live!
notes.content:
V1.01


 -Increased visual intensity on active Scan Probes slightly.
 -Added Safe Decal behind mining operation
 -Added more debris around less-used routes
 -Tweaked intro scanners
 -Added warning for when game window has no Focus!
 -Improved AI ship flight during spawns
 -Fixed issue where spawning spawns would flicker for 1 frame
 -Improved randomness of AI's 'human-ness' factor


We're hard at work on the next level, which includes new ships to fly, an all-new level, along with further balance changes based on the community feedback!

notes.title: 🚀 Astro Heist Launch Day! 🚀
notes.content:
🚀 Astro Heist - Now Available on Steam! 🚀

Greetings, space aficionados!

The moment you've all been waiting for has finally arrived. We are thrilled to announce that Astro Heist is now available for purchase and play on Steam!

Ready for a unique 2-player cosmic duel? Dive into a universe where you get to decide: will you be the cunning PC infiltrator, breaching defenses in pursuit of treasure? Or will you take on the role of a vigilant VR guardian, defending your space outpost objectives from intruders?

🌌 Key Features 🌌


 Frantic PvP Action: Challenge friends locally or harness the power of Remote Play Together.
 Innovative PC vs. VR Gameplay: Experience a fresh take on multiplayer, where platform boundaries blur.
 Just One Copy Required: Engage with your rival where only one copy of the game is required.


We've poured our passion and dedication into crafting Astro Heist, and now we're beyond excited to share this stellar adventure with all of you. We're eagerly awaiting your feedback, strategies, epic space heist tales, and unforgettable moments.

Watch our play through via the link below showing a single session of how the game is played, along with commentary from us giving some insights into the development process:

🎮Astro Heist - Dev Plays

🔗Click here to embark on your Astro Heist journey!

A massive thank you to our community for your unwavering support and enthusiasm throughout the development process. The universe of Astro Heist awaits you!

Stay cosmic, The Astro Heist Development Team
